studies.predicted_reason: RCT: multicentre randomised trial. Progestagen: adjuvant medroxyprogesterone acetate (MPA). Population: women who had surgery for stage I endometrial carcinoma. Meets all criteria.

studies.study_title: A randomised trial of adjuvant progestagens in early endometrial cancer
studies.predicted_reason: RCT: randomised controlled trial. Progestagen: adjuvant progesterone. Population: women with Stage I/II endometrial cancer after surgery. Meets all criteria.

studies.study_title: A randomised trial of progestagens in the primary treatment of endometrial carcinoma
studies.predicted_reason: RCT: randomised trial. Progestagen: progestogens. Population: women with endometrial carcinoma treated with surgery (and radiotherapy). Explicitly an RCT of progestagen therapy in women who had surgery for endometrial cancer; however note it is described as 'primary treatment' rather than strictly adjuvant.

studies.study_title: Extracting summary statistics to perform meta‐analyses of the published literature for survival endpoints

studies.study_title: Aduvant progesterone therapy for stage 1 endometrial cancer

The abstract does not explicitly state 'randomised', but as per guidelines we include uncertain cases for full-text assessment.

studies.study_title: Adjuvant progestagen therapy improves survival in patients with endometrial cancer after hysterectomy. results of one‐institutional prospective clinical trial
